[Evidence details]
- Main campaign: six retained benchmarks x five frozen seeds.
- Mean compression: 12.53%; mean held-out delta utility: -0.000313 (descriptive).
- Madelon: 43.60% mean compression; held-out delta utility +0.00469.
- Abalone: 27.50% mean compression; held-out delta utility -0.00565.
- Prefiltered and full NSGA-II used the same 800-evaluation budget; the pooled held-out HV comparison was not significant after Holm correction (adjusted p=.4375).
- A found -1 certifies a witnessed threshold flip; finite sampling does not make sampled 0/+1 complete.
[/Evidence details]
